description: Import calendar events from a photo of a flyer/invite/schedule using Skylight's AI (event_importer). Pass exactly ONE of image_path (a local file — local installs), image_blob_key (on the hosted connector: call skylight_upload_slots first, PUT the file to the returned uploadUrl, then pass its blobKey) or image_inline (base64; small files only). Best-effort/UNVERIFIED: uploads the photo to S3 then posts an event_importer intent that references the latest upload (the server-side photo↔intent link is inferred from captured traffic, not confirmed). Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token (and the same file) proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). The preview names the file, detected mime, size and SHA-256; nothing is uploaded until it is confirmed. A blob-store upload is deleted once the intent is created (reported as blob.deleted) and kept if it fails. Poll skylight_get_auto_creation_intent / skylight_list_auto_creation_drafts, then skylight_approve_auto_creation.

category_ids.description: Family-member category ids to assign the imported events to.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

image_blob_key.description: Hosted deployments: the blobKey from skylight_upload_slots, after the file was PUT to its uploadUrl. Same types as image_path, max 200 MiB. The upload is deleted from the blob store once Skylight accepts it, and kept if the upload fails.

image_inline.description: The file itself as base64: {filename, contentBase64, mimeType?}. Small files only — the whole file rides inside one tool call (a hosted deployment caps a request at about 9.9 MiB). Same types as image_path; the bytes must match the type.

contentBase64.description: The file's bytes, standard base64 (line breaks and a "data:<type>;base64," prefix are tolerated).

filename.description: Filename the upstream will show — a bare name, no path, not starting with a dot. Its extension sets the MIME type when mimeType is omitted.

mimeType.description: MIME type, e.g. "image/jpeg". Default: inferred from the filename extension.

image_path.description: LOCAL installs only: absolute path to an image/video file inside the upload directories (SKYLIGHT_UPLOAD_DIR; by default ~/Pictures and ~/Downloads) (jpg, jpeg, png, heic, gif, webp, mp4, mov; max 200 MiB). Anything else — a file outside those directories, a hidden file, a symlink, or a file whose contents do not match its extension — is refused. Refused on a hosted deployment (the claude.ai connector): use image_blob_key there.

name: skylight_import_events_from_photo
